s: Livento Group operations started in 2017 as the internal team spearheaded the development of financial management software based on artificial intelligence for investment entities.
Our competitors are other A.I. database and algorithm programming companies delivering services to clients like banks and asset managers.
AI product has current revenues from our clients in the form of fees for our services, and we invest part of these back into the product’s continuous upgrade.
Our AI product continues in normal development, where our internal team is providing services to several investment houses for portfolio optimization.
